design_conditions: Keep five-second admission freshness and all Save guards unchanged
Expired metadata only for complete token-backed known valid row with age strictly greater than five seconds
Retain accepted frozen history only on exact source/run/layer/control identity and explicit otherwise-ready parent signal
No pending or unconsumed results during retention; unknown/token-less/invalid or changed environment still resets
Idle target changes preserve accepted rows, pending A-B-A invalidates
Keep persistent Excel engine, original formulas and freeze semantics unchanged
root_cause: Accepted history reset when ordinary age-out clears the admission observation key
